verdict.rationale: SavvyCal has a REST API with a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (17 paths) confirmed reachable at runtime, indicating an API reference exists, but there's no evidence of an interactive docs UI with runnable/try-it-out examples (e.g., Swagger UI, Postman collection, or code sandbox). missing for 10: evidence of an interactive 'try it now' console or embedded runnable code samples, confirmation the OpenAPI spec is surfaced in a browsable interactive reference page, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the interactive experience.
